description: This Scala source file defines a SparkListener implementation (StatsReportListener) that logs summary statistics for Spark stages upon completion, including task runtimes, shuffle bytes, fetch times, and runtime breakdowns. It also contains utility functions for statistical distribution analysis and formatting.

classes.name: StatsReportListener
classes.description: A SparkListener that logs stage completion statistics such as task durations, shuffle metrics, and runtime percentages.

classes.name: RuntimePercentage
classes.description: A case class representing the percentage of executor time, fetch wait time, and other time for a task.

methods.name: onTaskEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a task, storing its info and metrics.

methods.name: onStageCompleted
methods.description: Logs detailed statistics when a stage completes, including task runtimes, shuffle bytes, fetch times, and runtime breakdowns.

methods.name: getStatusDetail
methods.description: Generates a string summarizing the stage's status, including ID, name, failure reason, task count, and duration.
